title: llm-pricing-index prices.json
description: Per-model LLM API pricing, USD per 1M tokens. Root file always holds the current confirmed values only — historical changes are tracked via git log, not a history array. Most entries are the vendor's own official price; entries carrying source_kind="aggregator" are a reseller's selling price instead (see that field).

input_price_usd.description: Input token price, USD per 1M tokens.

output_price_usd.description: Output token price, USD per 1M tokens.

cache_read_price_usd.description: Cached/context-hit input price, USD per 1M tokens. Omit or null if the vendor doesn't publish a distinct cache-read rate for this model.

cache_write_price_usd.description: Cache write/creation price, USD per 1M tokens. Omit or null if the vendor doesn't publish a distinct cache-write rate for this model.

source_url.description: The official vendor pricing page this entry was verified against.

last_verified.description: ISO 8601 date this entry was last confirmed against source_url.

source_kind.description: Where this price came from. "vendor_official" = the model vendor's own pricing page (the default, and what every entry was before this field existed). "aggregator" = a reseller's public price (e.g. OpenRouter), which is that reseller's SELLING price and therefore typically HIGHER than the vendor's official rate. Consumers using this file as a price CEILING must not treat the two interchangeably: an aggregator number answers "what would the customer pay elsewhere", a vendor_official number answers "what does the model actually list for".
